tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the tab bar, card list and search bar. Seed colour.

tokens.name: card_bg
tokens.usage: ScriptCard and PipelineCard surface, and the active GroupTab's face. Carries name_fg and path_fg. Seed colour (`surface`).

tokens.name: card_hover
tokens.usage: Card surface under the pointer. Derived: surface shaded -3% on a light theme, +10% on a dark one. highlight_fg() checks label colours against this as well as card_bg.

tokens.name: status_bg
tokens.usage: StatusBar strip along the window's bottom edge. Derived: bg shaded -5% light / +5% dark.

tokens.name: header_bg
tokens.usage: AppHeader band behind the bolt mark and the create buttons. Carries fg_on_dark. Seed colour.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on every card, the gutter behind a card's icon buttons and their 1px separators, the PanedWindow sash, and the scrollbar thumb. Seed colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand hue: the ScriptCard's 5px left rail, the active GroupTab's label and 3px indicator, the Combobox focus ring, and the + Script / + Group / + Pipeline buttons. Seed colour.

tokens.name: accent2
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state for every accent-filled button. Derived: accent shaded -15%.

tokens.name: accent_wash
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a selected Combobox row, an active tab's hover, and a favourited card's star button. Derived: accent shaded +86% light / -55% dark.

tokens.name: bolt
tokens.usage: The lightning mark in the header and the Quick Run bar's toggle, and the current match in output search. Fixed across every theme -- it is the identity, not a themed surface.

tokens.name: bolt_hover
tokens.usage: Quick Run toggle under the pointer.

tokens.name: name_fg
tokens.usage: Primary text: card names, dialog body copy, entry text. Reads on bg, card_bg and card_hover.

tokens.name: path_fg
tokens.usage: Secondary text: script paths, last-run timestamps, the search glyph, the Combobox arrow. Reads on bg and card_bg.

tokens.name: fg_on_dark
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on header_bg, accent, pipe_accent, menu_bg and tooltip_bg.

tokens.name: fg_on_dark_2
tokens.usage: Muted text on the output panel's header and tab bar.

tokens.name: tab_fg
tokens.usage: Label on an inactive GroupTab. Reads on tab_inactive_bg.

tokens.name: btn_fg
tokens.usage: Label on every filled FlatButton (run, create, modify). Reads on btn_run_bg, btn_create_bg and error.

tokens.name: btn_run_bg
tokens.usage: Run button fill on cards and the Run Selected action.

tokens.name: btn_run_hover
tokens.usage: Run button under the pointer. Derived from btn_run_bg when a theme overrides it.

tokens.name: btn_mod_bg
tokens.usage: Modify / edit button fill. Tracks accent.

tokens.name: btn_mod_hover
tokens.usage: Modify button under the pointer. Tracks accent2.

tokens.name: btn_create_bg
tokens.usage: Header create buttons (+ Script, + Group, + Pipeline). Tracks accent.

tokens.name: btn_create_hover
tokens.usage: Header create buttons under the pointer. Tracks accent2.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_bg
tokens.usage: Unfilled icon buttons in a card's right-hand gutter: reorder, history, star. Derived: surface shaded -6% light / +8% dark.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_hover
tokens.usage: Neutral icon button under the pointer. Derived: surface shaded -12% light / +14% dark.

tokens.name: btn_neutral_fg
tokens.usage: Glyph on a neutral icon button. Tracks text_muted.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle
tokens.usage: Stop button fill while nothing is running. Fixed across themes -- the stop control reads the same everywhere.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle_fg
tokens.usage: Stop glyph while disabled.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle_active_fg
tokens.usage: Stop glyph while disabled and moused over.

tokens.name: btn_stop_idle_hover
tokens.usage: Disabled stop button under the pointer.

tokens.name: btn_stop_active
tokens.usage: Stop button fill while a job is running, and the pressed state of the retry Run button.

tokens.name: btn_stop_active_hover
tokens.usage: Armed stop button under the pointer.

tokens.name: btn_disabled_bg
tokens.usage: Slab of a control that is born disabled and never flips -- the palette default. A control that toggles calls disabled_pair() with its own colours instead. Derived: btn_neutral_bg mixed 45% toward card_bg, or shaded away from it where there is nowhere to mix toward.

tokens.name: btn_disabled_fg
tokens.usage: Label on a disabled control. Derived: btn_neutral_fg mixed toward its own slab in 24 steps until it drops to 2.6:1 -- dim enough to read as disabled, not so dim it vanishes.

tokens.name: btn_dark_bg
tokens.usage: The header's options (gear) button.

tokens.name: btn_dark_hover
tokens.usage: Options button under the pointer; also the StatusBar's text colour.

tokens.name: tab_inactive_bg
tokens.usage: Inactive GroupTab face and its 3px indicator. Derived: bg shaded -5% light / +6% dark.

tokens.name: tab_inactive_hover
tokens.usage: Inactive GroupTab under the pointer. Derived: bg shaded -10% light / +11% dark.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success badge fill on a card that last ran clean.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Fill for a card's in-flight run row.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failure badge fill, and the Run button's retry state after a failed run.

tokens.name: warn_bg
tokens.usage: SelectBar banner ground while multi-select is on.

tokens.name: warn_border
tokens.usage: SelectBar hairline, and the Select All button's hover fill.

tokens.name: warn_fg
tokens.usage: SelectBar text. Reads on warn_bg.

tokens.name: pipe_accent
tokens.usage: PipelineCard's 5px left rail and the SCHEDULED badge, separating a pipeline from a script at a glance.

tokens.name: pipe_accent2
tokens.usage: Pipeline hover and step connectors. Derived: pipe_accent shaded +12% when a theme overrides it.

tokens.name: out_bg
tokens.usage: Output panel ground. Fixed across themes by default: the terminal keeps a console's look whatever the chrome does.

tokens.name: out_header
tokens.usage: Output panel header strip and the Find bar.

tokens.name: out_tabbar
tokens.usage: Output panel per-job tab strip.

tokens.name: out_stdout
tokens.usage: stdout text in the output panel, set in the mono family.

tokens.name: out_stderr
tokens.usage: stderr text in the output panel.

tokens.name: out_status
tokens.usage: Runner status lines (started, exit code) in the output panel.

tokens.name: out_success
tokens.usage: Clean-exit line in the output panel.

tokens.name: menu_bg
tokens.usage: Right-click and options menu ground. Carries fg_on_dark; highlight swatches are re-shaded against this, not against card_bg.

tokens.name: menu_danger
tokens.usage: Destructive menu entries (Delete).

tokens.name: tooltip_bg
tokens.usage: Tooltip ground. Carries fg_on_dark.

tokens.name: tooltip_border
tokens.usage: Tooltip 1px hairline.

color.note: Eight of the thirteen palettes RYOS ships. Light and Dark are hand-tuned and used verbatim; the other six are expanded from a 7-colour seed by build_palette() in ryos/themes.py, so their derived values are exactly what the app paints.

type.note: Two OS families, no webfonts: RYOS is a Tk desktop app and asks the platform for Segoe UI and Consolas by name. Sizes below are the Tk point sizes converted at 96 dpi -- the usage note gives the point size the code passes.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The header's RYOS wordmark and bolt (Segoe UI 14 bold). The only type this large in the app.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card names in ScrollingLabel, and dialog section headings (Segoe UI 11 bold).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: GroupTab labels, search and quick-run entries, card gutter glyphs, menu entries (Segoe UI 10).

styles.name: control-strong
styles.usage: The active GroupTab's label (Segoe UI 10 bold).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dialog body copy, form labels, the SelectBar hint (Segoe UI 9). The app's workhorse size.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Script paths, last-run timestamps, the StatusBar, tooltips (Segoe UI 8).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: StatusBadge and ScriptTypeBadge text (Segoe UI 8 bold). Always on a filled ground.

styles.name: meta-italic
styles.usage: Empty-state and placeholder notes in dialogs (Segoe UI 8 italic).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Densest annotations in the pipeline step editor (Segoe UI 7). Do not go smaller.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Output panel body -- stdout, stderr and status lines (Consolas 10).

styles.name: terminal-compact
styles.usage: Output search field and the pipeline step command preview (Consolas 9).

spacing.note: Tk padx/pady values as the code passes them. There is no 4px or 8px grid: these are the eleven steps actually in use, ordered by size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tab wrapper inset that draws a tab's border, and the 1px frame around a HoverPreview.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap under a card's name row; compact-card row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between GroupTabs; tooltip vertical padding; small-card row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: StatusBar vertical padding, card row padding at medium size, Entry border inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Badge horizontal padding, FlatButton vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between header buttons, tooltip horizontal padding, GroupTab vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap beside the options button; quick-run entry left inset.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: StatusBar horizontal padding; compact-card horizontal padding; output header inset.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Card body horizontal padding at every size, FlatButton horizontal padding, search bar inset.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: GroupTab horizontal padding, SelectBar text inset, header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Dialog section padding -- the most common value in the dialogs module.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: AppHeader horizontal padding, setting the window's outer margin.

radius.note: RYOS is square. Tk frames have no corner radius and the app never fakes one; the single exception is the application icon, whose rounded rectangle is drawn at 24% of its canvas.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every card, button, badge, tab, banner, tooltip and panel. Separation comes from a hairline and a fill, never a corner.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The application icon's rounded rectangle only (make_icon.py). Not a UI value.

size.note: Structural line weights and fixed widths, in px.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Card border, tooltip border, SelectBar border, and the separators between a card's gutter buttons.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The coloured strip down a card's left edge: accent on a ScriptCard, pipe_accent on a PipelineCard.

tokens.name: tab-indicator
tokens.usage: The bar under a GroupTab -- accent when active, tab_inactive_bg when not.

tokens.name: sash
tokens.usage: The PanedWindow sash between the card list and the output panel, gripless.

tokens.name: scrollbar-arrow
tokens.usage: ttk scrollbar and Combobox arrow size.
